review.notes: Trigger condition, effect type (EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE+EFFECT_TYPE_TRIGGER_O on EVENT_BATTLE_DESTROYED) and filter are byte-identical between goat/c504700162.lua and official/c93107608.lua; the only differences are the two listed above. Text lineage v0 (SOD-EN025, 2004-10-01) -> v1 (DR3-EN025, 2006-11-25) -> v2 (DL13-EN007, 2011-12-01) -> v3 (SBC1-END06, 2023-08-24) is entirely cosmetic: "destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle" -> "destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard/GY", "Insect-Type" -> "Insect", and the dropped procedural line "Then shuffle your Deck." No behavioural text transition, hence modern_text_version null. Verification-half bounds: old attested through 2011-02-02, modern from 2019-04-03.

event.historical_text: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can Special Summon 1 Insect-Type monster with an ATK of 1500 or less to your side of the field from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.
event.summary: Period ruling package, not a text erratum. Activation condition: the modern `s.target` requires `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,...)` - an Insect with 1500 or less ATK actually in the Deck - while the goat target requires only a free Monster Zone, so the battle-destruction trigger can be used on a whiff. Failed-search verification: the goat operation adds `else Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)`, revealing the Deck to prove no eligible Insect remains. The verification half falls under the shared search-verification chronology; the relaxed activation condition is undated for this card, so the change is left chronologically unresolved.
